question: How many customers are from Germany?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Germany'
distractor: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'Germany'

question: What is the total revenue (sum of invoice totals) from customers located in Canada? Round to 2 decimals.
gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Canada'
distractor: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Canada' AND i.BillingCountry = 'Canada' AND i.InvoiceDate >= '2010-01-01'

question: How many distinct artists have at least one album in the database?
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ArtistId) FROM Album
distractor: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Artist
mistake: counts all artists, including those without albums

question: How many tracks belong to the 'Rock' genre?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'
distractor: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name LIKE '%Rock%'

question: Which country had the highest total invoice revenue (by billing country)?
gold: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1
distractor: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY AVG(Total) DESC LIMIT 1
mistake: ranks by average invoice rather than total revenue

question: What is the average invoice total, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) FROM Invoice
distractor: SELECT ROUND(AVG(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) FROM InvoiceLine il

question: How many invoices were issued in the first quarter (January to March) of 2012?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2012-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2012-04-01'
distractor: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) IN ('01', '02', '03')

question: Which employee (first and last name) supports the most customers?
gold: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
distractor: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks are longer than 5 minutes?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 300000
distractor: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 5 * 60 * 100

question: How many customers are supported by an employee whose title is 'Sales Support Agent'?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId WHERE e.Title = 'Sales Support Agent'
distractor: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent'

question: What is the name of the longest track (by duration)?
gold: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1
distractor: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Bytes DESC LIMIT 1
mistake: largest file size, not longest duration

question: How many distinct customers bought at least one track from the 'Jazz' genre?
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.CustomerId) FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'
distractor: SELECT COUNT(i.CustomerId) FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'

question: Which album has the most tracks? Give its title.
gold: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
distractor: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId ORDER BY SUM(t.Milliseconds) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many playlists contain at least one track?
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PlaylistId) FROM PlaylistTrack
distractor: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Playlist

question: What is the total number of tracks sold (sum of quantities) across all invoices?
gold: SELECT SUM(Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine
distractor: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TrackId) FROM InvoiceLine
mistake: counts distinct tracks, not units sold

question: How many customers live in a city where at least one other customer also lives?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE City IN (SELECT City FROM Customer GROUP BY City HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
distractor: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT City FROM Customer GROUP BY City HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

question: How many tracks have no composer listed?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NULL
distractor: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Composer = ''

question: What is the total revenue from the 'Classical' genre? Round to 2 decimals.
gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Classical'
distractor: SELECT ROUND(SUM(t.UnitPrice), 2) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Classical'
mistake: sums catalogue prices instead of sales

question: How many employees report directly to the General Manager?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo = (SELECT EmployeeId FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'General Manager')
distractor: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL
mistake: counts everyone who reports to anyone

question: Which artist's tracks have the longest total playing time? Give the artist's name.
gold: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY SUM(t.Milliseconds) DESC LIMIT 1
distractor: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
mistake: ranks artists by number of albums

question: How many customers made purchases totalling more than $45 over all their invoices?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT CustomerId FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId HAVING SUM(Total) > 45)
distractor: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId) FROM Invoice WHERE Total > 45 / 7.0
mistake: per-invoice threshold instead of per-customer total

question: What is the most common media type among tracks?
gold: SELECT m.Name FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
distractor: SELECT m.Name FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks are in the playlist named 'Music' (the one with the lowest id)?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PlaylistTrack WHERE PlaylistId = (SELECT MIN(PlaylistId) FROM Playlist WHERE Name = 'Music')
distractor: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Music'

question: What is the average track length in seconds for the 'Metal' genre, rounded to the nearest second?
gold: SELECT ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 1000.0) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Metal'
distractor: SELECT ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 1000.0) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name IN ('Metal', 'Heavy Metal')

question: Which customer (first and last name) has spent the most in total?
gold: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1
distractor: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity) DESC, c.CustomerId LIMIT 1
mistake: most tracks bought, not most money spent

question: How many invoices have a total strictly greater than the average invoice total?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE Total > (SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice)
distractor: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE Total > (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice * Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine)
mistake: compares with the average invoice line, not the average invoice

question: How many different genres has the customer with CustomerId 1 bought tracks from?
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId WHERE i.CustomerId = 1
distractor: SELECT COUNT(t.GenreId) FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId WHERE i.CustomerId = 1

question: In which year were the most invoices issued?
gold: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) FROM Invoice GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, 1 LIMIT 1
distractor: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) FROM Invoice GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many albums have no tracks in the 'Rock' genre?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId AND g.Name = 'Rock')
distractor: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.AlbumId) FROM Album a JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name <> 'Rock'
mistake: albums with some non-rock track, not with no rock tracks

question: What is the total duration of all tracks on the album 'Let There Be Rock', in whole minutes (rounded down)?
gold: SELECT SUM(t.Milliseconds) / 60000 FROM Track t JOIN Album a ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId WHERE a.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'
distractor: SELECT SUM(t.Milliseconds) / 6000 FROM Track t JOIN Album a ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId WHERE a.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'

question: How many customers are located in the USA and have a company listed?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'USA' AND Company IS NOT NULL
distractor: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'USA' OR Company IS NOT NULL

question: What is the highest unit price of any track?
gold: SELECT MAX(UnitPrice) FROM Track
distractor: SELECT MAX(Total) FROM Invoice

question: How many tracks appear in at least 3 different playlists?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT TrackId FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY TrackId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT PlaylistId) >= 3)
distractor: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT TrackId FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY TrackId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT PlaylistId) > 3)

question: Which sales support agent (first and last name) is associated with the highest total invoice revenue from their customers?
gold: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1
distractor: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY AVG(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1
mistake: highest average invoice, not highest total

question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t WHERE t.TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine)
distractor: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId WHERE il.Quantity = 0

question: What percentage of invoices were billed to the USA? Round to 1 decimal.
gold: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(BillingCountry = 'USA') / COUNT(*), 1) FROM Invoice
distractor: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'USA') / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer), 1)
